name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Set the pulleys high, grab a handle in each hand and step forward so the cables are behind you.
Stand with one foot slightly forward, torso leaning a little forward and a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring your hands together in an arc down and in front of your hips or chest.
Squeeze your chest for a second at the end of the movement.
Open your arms slowly back to the start, feeling a stretch across the chest.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A cable chest fly that brings the hands together in front of the body, keeping tension on the chest throughout.
